summary: Update the authoring skills to match the decisions
riskReason: The skills drive how every future intent and plan gets written, so a wrong rule spreads.

rules: structure-request: a question can name an owner; a decision that needs someone else's confirmation stays open, owned by them; acceptance criteria never name stakeholders; intents are JSON, written through the CLI

propose-plan: the agent proposes and the human approves; one step per logical change, listing every symbol it touches; the six kinds; a risk and a one-line reason on every step; each kind's expectation shape; links and cross-intent dependencies

evidence: every decision that affects authoring appears as a rule in one of the skills
a dry run of each skill on a small request produces output that validates
